title: Closure and transition decisions
intro: Delivery, adoption, validated value and closure are four separate statuses. Closure is a governed action: G6 approval alone closes nothing, and value still pending Finance validation needs an approved transition decision.
arProvisional: Provisional Arabic translation of the status labels.

transformation.title: Transformation status
transformation.intro: Each status is shown as the system records it; none is derived from another.
transformation.closeDescription: Closure needs the G6 (Sustain) business approval, each benefit validated by Finance or covered by an approved transition decision, and every performance area in BAU. The transformation is not archived: performance areas, KPI actuals, the improvement backlog and lessons continue.

value.validated_with_transition: Validated or covered by a transition decision

adoptionSource.indicator: From an adoption indicator below trajectory

initiatives.title: Initiative statuses
initiatives.intro: Setting delivery complete leaves adoption, validated value and closure unchanged. A delivered initiative whose value is pending keeps the value-pending label until Finance validates it or a transition decision is approved.
initiatives.empty: This transformation has no initiative yet.
initiatives.completeDescription: Only a launched initiative can be marked delivery complete. Adoption, validated value and closure do not change.
initiatives.adoptionDescription: The Business Owner's assessment of adoption. It is never derived from delivery.
initiatives.closeDescription: An initiative closes only when its delivery is complete and each of its benefits is validated by Finance or covered by an approved transition decision.

decisions.title: Benefit transition decisions
decisions.intro: A transition decision documents who owns the residual benefit and how it is monitored after closure, for value still to be realized.
decisions.businessApproval: a transition decision is decided through a business approval inside the product (Sponsor or the configured authority; never the requester). It never approves an engineering delivery gate.
decisions.forecastStays: Forecast stays forecast: a transition decision records no validated value, and the benefit's forecast is still reported as forecast. Monitoring tasks go to the residual owner.
decisions.empty: No transition decision has been recorded.
decisions.formDescription: Saved as a draft. It is decided only after you submit it.
decisions.firstMonitoringHint: On or before the expected realization end.
decisions.submitBody: The decision is sent for a business approval. Its content is frozen while it is in approval.
decisions.resubmitBody: The returned decision is sent again on the same business approval, in its next round, for the version you edited.
decisions.withdrawBody: A withdrawn decision is final. An open business approval is withdrawn with it.
decisions.requesterOnly: Only the requester can submit again or withdraw while it is in approval.

basis.validated_value_and_transition_decision: Basis: validated value and an approved transition decision

records.title: Closure records
records.intro: Each closure is recorded once and never edited.
